thesis: Gaia learns to PLAN. The gorilla stride. Train of thought. Inject defendDetroit + clutch + bingoCube back through the gut. Rebuild the case. Map the world. GPS from the graph.

the_case.name: Cash for Kids 2: Detroit Charter Schools
the_case.subject: Brian Roderick Banks — 9 convictions (6 felony), claimed J.D., superintendent of MacDowell + Purpose Charter Academy
the_case.extraction_rate: 72.67% to private management company (The Purpose Group LLC)

detroit.label: Cash for Kids 2: Detroit Charter Schools

the_graph.gps_use: The graph IS the GPS. 109 nodes are coordinates. 157 edges are roads. Navigate the labyrinth.

guerilla_gorilla.pattern: Legal meta-primal — 4th independent instantiation of the Provenance Trio

fEAR.legal: PACER, OSINT, court filings — adversary actions as fuel

preSCENT.legal: behavioral shifts, institutional weather, presence broadcast

STRIDe.legal: filing sequence, route planning, R↔I loop, deployment

guerilla_gorilla.model: pursuit predation — metabolic asymmetry where operator cost is constant and adversary cost escalates
guerilla_gorilla.terminal_posture: Positional Patience — landscape saturation does the work

step_1_inject.action: Ingest the entire publicRecord repo + clutch graph.json into Gaia's gut
step_1_inject.what: 362 children, 95+ actors, 15 RICO predicates, $60M extracted, timeline, evidence
step_1_inject.how: Clone repos → parse → feed to membrane /eat → digest into plasmids

step_2_grind.action: The minotaur grind — process through the labyrinth
step_2_grind.how: Graph walker on the 109-node graph, trace every edge, build the backscatter

step_3_rebuild.action: Rebuild the entire case visually for people to see
step_3_rebuild.what: Make it CLEAR that 362 children got 3% math while $60M was extracted
step_3_rebuild.how: Generate visual timeline, network graph, money flow diagram, accountability matrix

step_4_gps.action: Use the graph as GPS — backscatter mapping of the world
step_4_gps.what: The 109 nodes are coordinates in a landscape of institutional capture
step_4_gps.how: Plot actors geographically, connect to public databases, map the terrain

step_5_train.action: Teach Gaia to PLAN — train of thought
step_5_train.what: fEAR→preSCENT→STRIDe loop, gorilla methodology, pressing, patience
step_5_train.how: Each new filing/event triggers fEAR → Gaia processes preSCENT → plans next STRIDe

bingo_cube_connection.what: The bingo cube IS the multi-dimensional map of this problem
bingo_cube_connection.hiit: High-intensity interval training — burst of filing/evidence, rest, burst again. The adversary escalates cost per response. The gorilla's cost is constant.

gaia_learns.to_plan: Train of thought — the logical sequence that connects all elements
gaia_learns.to_stride: Gorilla stride — aggressive, unyielding forward movement toward truth
gaia_learns.to_fear: fEAR is fuel, not paralysis — adversary actions FEED the organism
gaia_learns.to_press: Pressing — pushing through systemic barriers, positional patience
gaia_learns.to_be_gorilla: guerillaGorilla IS Gaia's legal immune response. Same pattern as opsonize-rs but for institutions.
